verdict.rationale: Fin documents escalation to humans: it 'transfers to agents directly in preferred Inbox', has escalation guidance and rules, an 'Escalate to a human' API endpoint (Preview only), and JavaScript hand-off. Transferring into the same inbox implies the agent sees the conversation thread, and the inbox can show integration data alongside it. Nothing in the pack shows an auto-generated handoff summary or that details Fin collected are passed to the human. missing for 10: an explicit handoff summary for the human agent, evidence that collected customer details are forwarded at escalation, explicit confirmation that the full transcript carries over (including when handing off to third-party helpdesks), and independent or hands-on corroboration that customers don't have to repeat themselves.
